indexes.//: Order history: filter by owner, newest first. Firestore requires a composite index whenever a query combines an equality filter with an orderBy on a different field.
Reviews for one product, newest first.

Abandoned-cart sweep (api/_routes/cron-abandoned-cart.ts): carts still 'started' and old enough to remind, oldest-ready first. Without this index the query throws FAILED_PRECONDITION and the daily cron sends nothing.

Autocomplete search (api/_routes/search.ts): array-contains on searchTerms plus a stock > 0 filter is an array-contains + range combination, which also needs a composite index. Without it every call 500s.
